content.short: Decentralized system for issuing and verifying documents on Cardano blockchain.
content.description: Blockademia is a system that wants to tackle the issue of certificate forgeries. Whether it is a falsified certificate, credential or a diploma it often causes significant economic losses, reputation problems and even danger to human life. Blockademia wants to solve this by allowing institutions or businesses who issue certificates to issue them on the Cardano blockchain. When a certificate is issued on the blockchain, it cannot be edited or deleted, it is stored there permanently.
content.meta: Find out about Blockademia (ACI) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
